messages:
Mara: Heads-up — planning a staggered launch for inference-routing v3. Target window: Thu 09:30 PT. Need a deploy owner + smoke check lead and rollback owner. Proposal: staged percentage ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> full) over ~90 mins with checks between steps. Who can take what?

Devon: I can own the deploy and rollback. I’ll be on the call from 09:15–11:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Jia: I’ll run smoke and can automate the checks. Will prepare health/golden prompts and latency/errrate metrics. Quick checklist I’ll run after each step: 1) p50/p95 latency, 2) error rate, 3) token cost spike.

Jia: Smoke commands I’ll use:```
# smoke script
./tools/smoke.sh --endpoint=prod --model=infer-v3 --qps=3 --verify-resp
# basic health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .
```

Ryan: I’ll monitor traces and SLO dashboards. I’ll also enable an alert: errors > 0.8% sustained for 5m -> paging. I can mute non-critical noise for the window.

Mara: For segmentation, let's target a small percentage of normal web traffic and exclude enterprise customers, SSO flows, and any customers in the compliance pilot. Suggested segments: ["web-standalone-us-west", "mobile-beta-us-east"]. Agree?

Devon: Agree on segments. I’ll configure routing to only pick traffic tag "beta-small". Rollout plan I’ll execute:
- 09:30 PT: 1% for 15m (sanity)
- 09:45 PT: 10% for 25m (observe)
- 10:10 PT: 50% for 30m (scale check)
- 10:40 PT: promote to 100% if green

Jia: After each step I’ll paste a short status: OK or FAIL + short note (latency/error). If FAIL -> immediate rollback.

Devon: Rollback command ready:```
# rollback to stable revision
redwoodctl rollout set --service=inference-routing --revision=stable --reason="post-canary-fail"
```
I’ll execute rollback and announce in this thread.

ops-bot: Deployment window locked for service=inference-routing from 2027-03-11T09:30:00-07:00 to 2027-03-11T11:00:00-07:00. Reminder: attach post-mortem if rollback occurs.

Ryan: I’ll keep an eye on traces and group alerts by error fingerprint to avoid noise. If we see a new dominant fingerprint, I’ll call it out and pause.

Mara: Cool. Can each of you confirm by EOD today so I can post the runbook in the calendar invite?

Devon: Confirmed. I’ll also be prepared to cut a hotfix branch if needed.

Jia: Confirmed. I’ll drop the smoke checklist link in the runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/smoke/infer-v3-checklist

Ryan: Confirmed. I’ll add dashboard links in the invite.

Mara: Awesome — thanks team. I’ll update the invite with segments + runbook and tag this thread when it’s live. :rocket:
